newsitem.title: SYRIA: Russia's Primakov in Syria for Middle East talks.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Primakov in Syria for Middle East talks.

text.p: Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov arrived in Damascus on Monday at the start of a regional tour to revive the faltering Middle East peace process.
Primakov was welcomed at Damascus airport by Syrian Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara.
The two ministers were due to open talks later on Monday and Primakov would also meet president Hafez al-Assad during his visit, officials said.

The Russian ITAR-Tass news agency said earlier that Primakov's tour which will also take him to Lebanon, Egypt, Jordan, Israel and the Palestinian self-ruled areas, was aimed at demonstrating Moscow's support for the region's shaky peace process.
Russian Foreign Ministry spokesman Gennady Tarasov said Moscow considered Primakov's visit particularly important in view of Russia's role as co-sponsor in the Middle East peace process.
